Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew.
“It was with the heart of Joash” is rendered “Joash decided,” and “renew” as “restore.”
“As often as a year in a year” is rendered “annually.”
“The chief” is rendered “the chief priest.” “The tax of Moses … and of the assembly” is rendered “the levy fixed by Moses … on the congregation”; the Hebrew phrase is ambiguous.
“Athaliah the wickedness” is rendered “the wicked Athaliah.”
“Said” is rendered “commanded.”
“Tax” is rendered “levy.”
“Officials” is rendered “officers”; NASB supplies “their levies.”
“The officer of the priest of the head” is rendered “the chief priest's officer,” and “to a day in a day” as “daily.”
“The doer of the work” is rendered “those who did the work,” and “renew” as “restore.” “Craftsmen” is rendered “carpenters.”
“The repair went up” is rendered “the repair work progressed,” and “on its measurement” as “according to its specifications.”
“Articles” is rendered “utensils,” and “offering up” as “the burnt offering.”
“Became old and satisfied with days” is rendered “reached a ripe old age.”
“With God” is rendered “to God.”
“Leaders” is rendered “officials.”
“Asherah poles” is rendered “Asherim”; “in this their guilt” is rendered “for this their guilt.”
“Warned” is rendered “testified against,” and “gave ear” as “listen.”
“Clothed” is rendered “came on.” “And you will not prosper” is rendered “and do not prosper”; NASB supplies “Because.”
“Stoned him with stones” is rendered “stoned him to death.”
“The loyalty” is rendered “the kindness,” “killed” as “murdered,” and “require” as “avenge.”
“The circuit of the year” is rendered “the turn of the year,” and “leaders” as “officials.”
“With smallness of men” is rendered “with a small number of men.”
The Hebrew has “sons of Jehoiada”; NASB reads “son,” as the ancient versions do. NASB uses parentheses, and “sicknesses great” is rendered “very sick.”
Close to the Hebrew.
The phrase about the oracles is difficult in Hebrew; NASB renders it “the many oracles against him,” and the meaning is uncertain. “Founding” is rendered “rebuilding,” and “record” as “treatise.”
